title: Juicy Maqluba with Beetroot and Eastern Flair
description: A twist on the classic Middle Eastern dish Maqluba, featuring the sweetness of beetroot and a blend of eastern spices.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the diced beetroot and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
In a separate pan, heat 1 tbsp of olive oil over medium heat.
Add the crumbled feta and cook until lightly browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the cooked Jewelled Rice to the pan and stir to combine with the feta.
Add the Eastern Spice Blend to the rice mixture and stir to combine.
Add the cooked beetroot mixture to the rice mixture and stir to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the Maqluba hot, garnished with chopped parsley.
